name: The Salon on the Grand
description: The Salon on the Grand is a welcoming hair salon in Fergus, Ontario offering cuts, colour, balayage, blowouts, and treatments — beautiful, healthy hair by the Grand River.

hero.title: Beautiful hair, right on the Grand.
hero.subtitle: Cuts, colour, balayage, and blowouts in a warm, welcoming salon in Fergus, Ontario. Call 519-787-0500 to book your appointment.

stylists.name: Owner
stylists.title: Owner & Stylist
stylists.bio: The owner of The Salon on the Grand created a warm, welcoming space in Fergus where every client feels at home. From fresh cuts to soft, lived-in colour, every appointment is about healthy hair and leaving with a smile. Call 519-787-0500 to book.

reviews.name: Sarah M.
reviews.text: Love this salon! My balayage turned out beautifully and the whole experience was so relaxing.

reviews.name: Jenna K.
reviews.text: Best haircut I've had in Fergus. Friendly, professional, and they really listen.

reviews.name: Rachel D.
reviews.text: Such a cozy, welcoming salon. My colour is perfect and my hair feels so healthy.

reviews.name: Brittany L.
reviews.text: They did my wedding hair and it held up all night. Couldn't recommend them more!
